bio: I am a joint PhD student (2023–2027, expected) at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGSNRR, CAS), and the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC).

My research integrates LUCC-related products and spatial statistics to investigate the Food–Water–Ecosystem (F–W–E) nexus, with a particular focus on the impacts of agricultural activities on local water resources and ecosystems.
highlights: Groundwater depletion and cropping pattern shifts in Northeast China (Journal of Hydrology, 2025).
Crop residue burning dynamics and environmental impacts (Geography and Sustainability, 2025).
